scope: Independent manual review of the 16 confirmed-missing selections in sample/selection.json. Raw Oracle objects and all published rulings are archived per Oracle ID in sample/cards and sample/rulings. Assay compile is guidance; only the two registered extensions have new engine execution evidence. Research strata are lexical sampling, never objective classification rules.

cards.name: Krenko's Command
cards.review: Fixed count two, red 1/1 Goblins, under the caster's control. Native CreateToken and spell timing/costs; five new engine scenarios. Structural token-objective match for Judith and Krenko; no A/B contribution.

cards.name: Bitterblossom
cards.review: Owner-upkeep StepEvent, mandatory LoseLife then black flying Faerie Rogue CreateToken. Kindred Enchantment, not a creature. Six engine scenarios cover both controllers, opponent upkeep, source removal, one life and protected zero life. Life loss is not payment. Structural token-objective match for Judith and Marrow-Gnawer; not A/B.

cards.name: Soul of Zendikar
cards.review: Reviewed model has reach, a mana activation and a distinct graveyard activation with exile-as-cost, each creating a 3/3 green Beast. SDK graveyard functional-zone/cost primitives exist. Ready for assisted authoring, with tests still required for zone guards, removal in response, costs and independent activations. Not implemented or mechanically verified here.

cards.name: Mortarpod
cards.review: Grammar gap at Living weapon, not evidence of missing token SDK support. ColossalDreadmask demonstrates atomic CreateToken then AttachEquipment(CREATED_TOKENS); GrantActivatedAbility and equip primitives exist. Manual authoring requires LKI damage source tests, creature sacrificing itself, attachment before SBA, token survival and multiple-token replacement boundaries. No claim that merely compiling the token half implements the Equipment.

cards.name: Rakdos Guildmage
cards.review: Reviewed model retains hybrid identity BR, discard cost and targeted temporary -2/-2, plus a separate red 2/1 hasty Goblin with next-end-step exile. Existing SDK primitives cover the model. Assisted authoring still needs mana/discard, target, delayed exile and activation-during-end-step tests. Hybrid may be paid with one color but full deck identity requires both.

cards.name: Pact of the Titan
cards.review: Grammar declines the delayed upkeep sentence. Native delayed triggers, PayOrSuffer and LoseGame exist; the token alone is not a faithful definition. Manual authoring must preserve next owner upkeep, obligation after the Giant leaves, countered-spell absence of obligation, payment choice and actual game loss. No new SDK gap proven.

cards.name: Espers to Magicite
cards.review: Deceptive creature-card copy: the resulting token loses all other card types and is an artifact, so source-led review predicts it does not create a creature token by itself. Native CreateTokenCopyOfTarget.overrideCardTypes supports replacing types. Complete exiled-card collection binding, optional reflexive target selection and priority window require further authoring/scenario proof; not declared an engine gap or an executed objective nonmatch.

cards.name: Transpose
cards.review: The lexical opponent-token sampling stratum selected an adversarial case: opponent appears in the created Wizard's damage trigger, not as token receiver. Token creation is conditional on cast-from-hand; rebound recast still draws/discards/loses life without another token. Grammar declines the hand-origin clause. SDK rebound and granted token abilities exist, but cast-origin propagation and the child trigger source need scenario proof. No automatic receiver inference was made.

cards.name: Burakos, Party Leader
cards.review: Treasure creation is not creature-token creation. It also changes source creature types, counts a party using distinct-role assignment, targets defending player's life and permits Background construction. No tested party-cardinality primitive was established in this bounded review; faithful expression remains unresolved rather than substituting raw creature count. Ordinary black deck inclusion does not grant a second commander.

cards.name: Solemn Doomguide
cards.review: Grammar lacks this graveyard grant/filter sentence. Mishra, Tamer of Mak Fawa demonstrates GrantActivatedAbility(unearthAbility, recipientZone=GRAVEYARD); a union of four creature subtypes supplies the filter. Manual authoring must test per-card ownership, sorcery timing, dynamic gain/loss of the grant, haste and unearth leave-battlefield replacement. Existing graveyard primitives are not proof that the application's current objective walker recognizes the grant.

cards.name: Sigil of Myrkul
cards.review: Native ReflexiveTriggerEffect and TriggerDetector support a real response/target-selection window after milling, unlike a single pretargeted trigger. Count-four graveyard condition, controlled target, counter and temporary deathtouch have existing primitives. Manual authoring must test threshold change after milling, empty library and reflexive target timing. Token objective negative by source review, not an evaluated native nonmatch.

cards.name: Dread Linnorm // Scale Deflection
cards.review: Explicit Assay compiler packaging limitation, not missing native multi-face capability. Native CardDefinition.cardFaces/adventure support exists. Manual authoring must retain one physical green Oracle identity, adventure characteristics on stack, exile permissions only after resolving as Adventure, creature block restriction and the instant's untap/counters/hexproof on an already-untapped target. No token creation by source review.

cards.name: Undead Servant
cards.review: Grammar gap in source-named graveyard count. Native DynamicAmount.Count with a name predicate and dynamic CreateToken quantity can express the resolution-time number. A source entering with zero copies creates zero; a source dying in response may count itself. Native card-name literals belong in authored filters, never discovery exceptions. Requires these scenarios before registration.

cards.name: Touch of the Void
cards.review: Devoid does not erase red color identity. Existing damage, Devoid and MarkExileOnDeath primitives are relevant, but Carbonize's unconditional target marking is not sufficient evidence for 'a creature dealt damage this way'. Prevented damage versus actual damage, lethal damage and a later unrelated death must be tested. Do not drop the replacement rider or claim a death-generation result.

cards.name: Cloakwood Swarmkeeper
cards.review: Ability-word/grammar gap. Native token entry batch events and AddCounters are available, but authoring must verify 'one or more' once per batch, any token type, controller restriction and multiple independent batches. Independent negative token-objective case: this card rewards token entry and never creates a token itself. Not translated or labeled an executed NO_MATCH.

cards.name: Pain's Reward
cards.review: Confirmed SDK/engine mismatch with the available OpenLifeBidEffect: that primitive fixes opening bid at one, has two bidders and runs onWin only for the caster. Pain's Reward permits any opening bid, all players, bids above life and draw-four for whoever wins. Reusing it would silently change rules; additional mechanical support is required. No token objective contribution by source review.
